metadata.description: Real document categories commonly requested during Indian education and counselling workflows. Exact requirements depend on the authority and candidate.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify time-sensitive details on the linked official source before relying on them.
notes: This is a reference checklist, not a universal mandatory list. Follow the current official counselling bulletin and institution instructions. Do not upload sensitive documents to a public assets directory.
Documents marked if applicable, if required, or authority-dependent must only be requested when the relevant authority, admission route or scheme requires them.
Store personal documents in access-controlled private storage; never place candidate uploads in a public static assets directory or expose them through public URLs.
Official URLs are starting points and do not confirm that every listed document is required for a particular admission cycle.
